interpretation: 12/24 large motif/content/layout errors do not exceed the registered majority rule; 3/24 contain plausible local smoothing with valid masks. reference_limit: Displayed reference crops themselves often lack clear high-frequency detail. This may make no-reference restoration equally effective; S2a must test this.
